scope: Not an executable launcher; future protocol steps after all prerequisites and coordinator permit
product_retry_behavior: Leave current product behavior unchanged; GenericProvider internal ECONNREFUSED handling is not a harness retry override.

steps.action: Validate versions/signature compatibility, original protocol state, profile/cache ownership and live owned feed/business endpoints; attach process/request observers before the first operation.
Launch exact unmodified baseline at stable task installation; verify packaged darwin/arm64, exact old version, Electron and Node home/cache paths, configuration and preferences.
Attach real window.updater.onUpdateDownloaded and onDownloadProgress callbacks before triggering a check; retain synthetic sentinels using only task profile.

steps.meaning: Actual manual check auto-downloads with current product even when automaticUpdates=false; not executed here.

steps.action: Observe actual metadata/ZIP GETs, checksum/downloadedFile, wrapper download event and subsequent Squirrel native readiness/errors. Default first private-cache download uses full ZIP if no previous update.zip.

steps.meaning: Calls production updater:install; MacUpdater coordinates native Squirrel quit/install. No manual copy/rewrite substitute.

steps.action: Require actual installed candidate executable/ASAR/CLI hashes and restarted app version; attach/relaunch only the same owned installation as needed to collect proof. Re-read same profile configuration/preferences/sentinels.
Close owned app/feed/native proxy, preserve owned raw evidence and caches for diagnosis, unregister only task-added scheme paths, and re-audit all owned process/port/mount/DB connections.
